shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat rectangular panel
repeated schematic sign-like motifs arranged in rows
animal/creature figures in profile (A) vs human figures (B) — only 'figural motifs' shared generically
justification: Both are low-relief panels organised into horizontal registers with repeated schematic signs and include a circular/disc element and curved arcs, which gives a loose structural resemblance. But the depicted content differs fundamentally: A shows abstracted animal/insect-like creatures, snake-like forms, H-shapes and zigzag bands with no human presence, while B shows a rayed sun disc above an offering table flanked by standing human figures over a dense field of small script-like signs.
